newsitem.title: UK: Straight-run fuel quiet in NWE, better in Med.
newsitem.headline: Straight-run fuel quiet in NWE, better in Med.

text.p: Straight-run activity in Europe improved with several deals done. A low sulphur straight-run 25kt cargo was sold out of Scandinavia in the low $140s while in the Mediterranean a low sulphur straight-run cargo was sold at low cif quotes delivered Augusta. Also in the Med an M-40 found a buyer at formula +$1.50-2.00, a realistic level given recent pressure on prices. The purchase by the Irish power utility ESB of 60,000 tonnes of Russian straight-run either side of $120 cif Ireland gave substance to those dealers who have said the market looks oversupplied and having difficulty sustaining premiums against cracked material. -- London Newsroom, +44 171 542 8980
